_comment: Toggle surface for the 'How I operate' highlights strip. Flip enabled:true/false and re-run `python3 scripts/build-highlights.py`. Disabled insights are NOT computed or emitted — they never reach the public page. Array order = display order. label/caption/accent are optional per-insight overrides.
